note: Page County Conservation Board's first park (1959), 22 acres with a 3-acre pond, on Hwy 2 about halfway between Shenandoah and Clarinda. Two reservable shelters. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15 base (the $6 sites are 2 primitive sites with no pad), 50 A + water, 12 sites, shower, first-come. Added season Apr 15 - Nov 1. Fit: pads 45-65 ft. Not waterfront (3-acre pond).
flags: FIT: electric sites have 45-65 ft gravel pads; a 23-ft motorhome fits.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The only water is the park's 3-acre pond (under 5 acres = pond; no pond-view).

PIN: the stored 40.742485,-95.222574 is at the park entrance on Hwy 2. NAIP shows the park drive looping north around the pond to a gravel lot and a small building near 40.7450,-95.2217, and Google's 'Pioneer Park' pin is 40.74523,-95.22266 (~300 m north of the stored pin), but no pads or parked rigs are visible on NAIP, so no corrected coordinates are proposed.
